name: detective-wall
description: Tauri desktop clue wall with a Rust backend and reviewed MCP proposals.

scripts.start: npm run build:server && cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --bin casegraph-server
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --lib && npm run build:server && node tests/rust-mcp.cjs && node tests/rust-http.cjs && node tests/rust-chat.cjs
